name: Warehouse Volunteers at Roadrunner Food Bank of New Mexico
org: Roadrunner Food Bank of New Mexico
what_you_do: Volunteers prep food for distribution in the warehouse. The food leaves the docks for hundreds of locations across the state. Shifts are at the Albuquerque warehouse.
who_can_apply: Teens 16 and older can volunteer without a parent or guardian, unless it is a school or group activity. Younger teens and kids must come with an adult.
duration: Shifts are 2 hours long, on weekdays and Saturdays.
deadline_text: No deadline. Sign up for open dates and times.
how_to_apply: Make an account in the online sign-up portal for individuals and families. Pick an open date and time. You get a confirmation email. Groups of five or more fill out a group form at least 3 weeks ahead.
notes: Teens under 16 can join with an adult. Children 8 and up can help in the warehouse with enough adults. Children must be 12 or older to work in the clean rooms. Wear closed-toe shoes and no tank tops.
